title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/003 (comparative): proposed lift in an existing commercial building, D1/D2
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Tauranga City Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; D2/AS2 second edition, amendment 7 (effective 1 January 2017) as cited
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The determination concerns an authority's refusal to grant building consent for a new lift in an existing two-storey commercial building.
The question is whether the new lift complies with clause D2 where clause D1.3.4 requires it.
The matter also considers whether to grant a waiver or modification in respect of those clauses.
Figure 2 is the proposed ground floor plan; Figure 3 is the proposed first floor plan.
Acceptable Solution D2/AS2 (second edition, amendment 7) is cited for the lift route.
